name: PinkFlash F03 Lasting Matte Foundation 25ml - All Shades Available
description:
PinkFlash Matte Foundation – 24H Natural Perfection

Get the flawless “No Makeup” makeup look with PinkFlash Matte Foundation. Designed for every girl who wants a naturally beautiful finish, this foundation combines high coverage, extreme matte control, and all-day wear in one lightweight formula.

Its superpower lies in its ability to cover imperfections such as acne, pores, and redness with ease—while still feeling weightless on the skin. With oil-control technology and waterproof durability, your makeup stays fresh and shine-free, even through the night.

✨ Key Features

Natural-looking finish

Extreme matte effect

24-hour long-lasting wear

High coverage for blemishes

Waterproof & oil-control formula

Lightweight and comfortable

🎨 Available Shades

Vanilla

Sand Beige

Warm Beige

Medium Peach

Tan Walnut

Tan
